sloka: क्षिप्रं वनमिदं सौम्य नरसङ्घै: समन्तत:।लुब्धैश्च सहितैरेभिस्त्वमन्वेषितुमर्हसि ॥ २.९८.३॥
transliteration: kṣipraṁ vanamidaṁ saumya narasaṅghai: samantata:।lubdhaiśca sahitairebhistvamanveṣitumarhasi ॥ 2.98.3॥

translations.english: O dear Satrughna, you should explore this forest quickly along with groups of our people and hunters as well.
